answer: The gale cap is enforced at intake and island exposes the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a signal tag. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 36 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
